name: frac-team-interface-agreement
description: Drafts a one-page agreement between a fractional leader and the people who carry the function on the off days, with what a complete request looks like, who decides what without you, the response window, the urgent route, a shared status view, and a one-cycle trial with a review date. Use for "run frac-team-interface-agreement", "work stops when I am not there", "working agreement with the team", "how does the team reach me on my off days", "who decides when I am with another client", "interface agreement for my fractional role", "requests keep coming back incomplete", part of the Claude for Fractional Leaders Pack by 90n.
